props.colour_source: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit, 2025 8k colour, original 32 southern rows; polar colour uses lower-resolution LOLA albedo fill; aesthetic only, not additional terrain measurements.
props.space_environment: Imported NASA Earth/Sun; 8k NASA Deep Star Map. Artistic placement and illumination.
props.demo_note: 4-second 1080p24 fully rendered animation. Approximate lighting/sky positions; measured terrain retained.
